answer: A workable design charges newcomers upfront and refunds on merit. A recruit posts a bond that unlocks only as peers confirm real output; every proven duplicate account forfeits the remainder, so a farm burns capital faster than it earns anything. In effect the ivory of free entry disappears, the pearl of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the delta case is a farm that funds its own destruction.
